title: PPT Deck
shortDescription: Full 78 card PPT tarot deck on 350gsm cardstock with japanese black core. Full color guide book included.
description: The PPT deck is a full 78 card tarot deck! Let the moonlight and magical girl engery guide you.  Made on 350gsm cardstock with japanese black core and lots of love.

title: PPT Bundle
shortDescription: Beatiful collector's box: PPT Tarot deck, Moonlight Oracle, PPT Journal, and matchsticks.
description: The full 78 card PPT tarot deck! 350gsm cardstock with japanese black core. A full color guide book is included with the deck.The full bundle comes with a journal to document your tarot readings, a mini oracle deck, and matchsticks to light your candles -- all in a beautiful collector's box.

title: PPT Matchbooks
description: The PPT Matchbooks feature your favorite senshi's wands! Inner Senshi has 2 rows of the main 5 (10 matches total) while the Outter Senshi has 2 rows of 10 (20 matches total).
